meta.drift_note: Per-process usage history: design.md/implement.md describe the original design at the time of completion; the current implementation has drifted. design.md/implement.md match the shipped behaviour. Note that `ProcessUsageAggregator.flush(using:)` was later removed because the sample interval is now fixed at 1 s; the regression test `ProcessUsageAggregatorTests.testFlushResetsBucket` pins the current implementation. Pointer: FlowTraceTests/ProcessUsageAggregatorTests.swift.
